name: 70818 · Baton Rouge, LA
findings: ZIP 70818 (Baton Rouge) has 32 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70818 (Baton Rouge) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 70818 (Baton Rouge) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 37% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 70818 (Baton Rouge) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
